name: backlog-desktop
description: The Claude Desktop half of the Backlog tooling, installed beside backlog-tools in Claude Desktop only: execute-plan, which runs a whole Backlog plan through nested Claude Desktop sessions with one worktree and pull request per entry; dispatch-sessions, the Manager session that turns each session request the app queues into a Claude Desktop session and hands each accepted answer back to the session waiting on it; a hook that reports each Claude Desktop scheduled run's start and finish to the app's Schedules page; and a function-hook module that shows a running plan's progress, with each entry's delivery-flow stages, in a band above the prompt and a pane. Depends on backlog-tools.
